checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

geographyAssessmentJa: 町の候補を保持する。ただしゴラン高原全域を示す広域マーカーにせず、都市位置候補未確認と表示する。
